We're exploring various ideas, including watercolor painting workshops and interactive art sessions that can engage the community and highlight local talent. What locations do you think would work well?

I agree, outdoor spaces in the park sound ideal for fostering a creative atmosphere. Maybe we could even collaborate on promoting the workshops together! Have you thought about how to reach out to potential participants?

We could also host a small event to introduce the workshops and get people excited. What do you think? Do you have any other ideas for outreach?

I think hosting a small event is a brilliant way to generate excitement! We could also consider reaching out to local businesses to see if they would be willing to sponsor or promote the workshops. What do you think about creating a partnership with them? It could help us gain more visibility.

Let’s brainstorm some potential business partners and how we can present this idea to them. I think it could be mutually beneficial! Do you have any specific businesses in mind that we could approach?

That sounds perfect, Yuriko! Let’s plan to meet on Thursday to work on the proposal. I'm excited about the potential of this collaboration and can’t wait to see how we can bring the community together through these workshops.  Do you have a time in mind for our meeting?
How about we meet in the afternoon, around 2 PM? That should give us enough time to brainstorm and draft our proposal. I'm really looking forward to it!
